meta.notes: Swiss file only, so no Liechtenstein addresses; planned (projektiert) addresses dropped, real ones kept whether or not ADR_OFFICIAL; id ADR_EGAID; house_number ADR_NUMBER as written; a decimal number like 31.1, GWR's sub-number for a secondary building of the entrance 31, marks a unit; road STN_LABEL; ZIP_LABEL split into postcode and city (the postal locality); state is the canton code COM_CANTON; LV95 EPSG:2056 transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:2056: Inverse of Swiss Oblique Mercator 1995 + CH1903+ to WGS 84 (1) + axis order change (2D)
